OCEAN CURRENT DATA IS RATHER VARIABLE, SO THAT DID NOT PRESENT MUCH HELP. NO SUSPECTED POINT SOURCE COULD BE IDENTIFIED VIA SATELLITE IMAGERY. GIVEN ALL THIS, CONFIDENCE ASSIGNED IS MEDIUM.

Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: CHEVRON PHILLIPS CHEMICAL CO.
Skytruth Analysis
DUE TO AN UNEXPECTED POWER FAILURE, OF WHICH THE ROOT CAUSE IS NOT KNOWN AT THIS TIME, THE OPERATING UNITS AT THE CHEVRON PHILLIPS SWEENY CHEMICAL COMPLEX SHUTDOWN. A SIGNIFICANT ELECTRICAL STORM THAT OCCURRED IN THE HOUSTON AREA THIS MORNING IS A POTENTIAL CONTRIBUTOR. ETHYLENE UNITS 22 AND 24 WERE SHUTDOWN. ETHYLENE UNIT 33 WAS ALREADY DOWN FOR MAINTENANCE; HOWEVER, EQUIPMENT THAT HAD NOT BEEN SHUTDOWN FOR MAINTENANCE WAS BROUGHT DOWN WITH THIS INCIDENT. THE NATURAL GAS LIQUIDS UNITS (UNITS 10ABC, 10D, 12, 18 & 21) ALSO WERE SHUTDOWN. THE FACILITY IS IN THE PROCES OF STABILIZING UNITS AND IMPLEMENTING CORRECTIVE ACTIONS.

Report Description
CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF USED HYDRAULIC OIL AND LUBE OIL ONTO THE GROUND FROM PIECES OF MACHINERY IN A MANUFACTURING SHOP DUE TO NEGLIGENCE, AND INCORRECT CONTAINMENT. STEEL GRINDINGS ARE NOT DISPOSED OF CORRECTLY AND ARE GETTING INTO EVERY PART OF THE BUILDING AND OUTSIDE FROM THE VENTILATION SYSTEM AS WELL AS INTO THE WORKERS LUNGS. THE WORKERS ARE NOT WEARING ANY PREVENTIVE GEAR EXCEPT EYE PROTECTION AND STEEL TOE BOOTS. THE MATERIAL HAS BEEN LEECHING INTO THE CONCRETE FLOOR FOR 50 YEARS. THE METAL GRINDINGS OUTDOORS ARE GETTING INTO A RUN OFF DITCH. THERE IS ALSO NO HAZARDOUS WASTE DISPOSAL PLAN OR EQUIPMENT. PARKING LOT IS LITTERED WITH SCRAP METAL.
